=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_stall_recovery_pr_lookup.py:785-811 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The _run_create_pr_recovery helper does not create ${RUNTIME_DIR}/pr-body-lint/body.txt before running the extracted Create Pull Request step.
  WHY: The hardened step exits immediately with `::error::expected PR body file missing: ...`, so the recovery tests fail before reaching gh pr create or the intended recovery logic.
- tests/test_stall_recovery_pr_lookup.py:865-907 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The exit-1 assertions for the empty-timeline, text-only-mention, and closed-PR cases are now satisfied by the missing-body-file guard instead of the recovery logic under test.
  WHY: Because _run_create_pr_recovery exits early on the absent body file, these tests no longer exercise the timeline traversal or open-PR matching they are meant to verify.
- .github/workflows/integration-pr-readiness.yml:72 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: GitHub pull-request context variables are interpolated directly into the shell execution context via environment variables.
  WHY: Branch names come from user input, so a malicious branch name could potentially inject shell commands; this matches the unsafe pattern that actionlint flags.
- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml:217-221 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Missing new unit test invocations added in the last autofix.
  WHY: Without the new invocations of test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py, test_lint_plan_archival_completeness.py, and test_check_integration_pr_readiness.py, the release pipeline will not run tests for these new safety checks.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3206-3211 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Missing new unit test invocations added in the last autofix.
  WHY: Without the new invocations of test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py, test_lint_plan_archival_completeness.py, and test_check_integration_pr_readiness.py, the release pipeline will not run tests for these new safety checks.
- docs/postmortems/2026-05-18-project-2734-stall.md:62-67 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Timeline entries out of chronological order.
  WHY: A postmortem timeline should be ordered by time, but currently shows 04:50 after 07:54, making the incident history confusing.
- tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py:22-35 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Missing new workflow exceptions for the three new lint workflows.
  WHY: Without adding integration-pr-readiness.yml, lint-plan-archival.yml, and lint-pr-body-auto-close.yml to the allowlist, the workflow checkout integration ref audit test will flag them as unexpected.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8595-8601 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The completeness gate filters only select(.status == "not_created").
  WHY: Sub-issues that were dispatched and then landed in non-terminal states like failed, stuck, or review-blocked are not caught, so an externally merged integration PR can be marked complete with work still in flight.
- scripts/check_integration_pr_readiness.py:49-58 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: All failure modes of gh issue view collapse to None.
  WHY: The caller posts an error commit status and returns 1 but cannot distinguish a missing issue from a transient API failure, so readiness checks fail-closed during GitHub incidents or rate-limit windows.
- scripts/lint_plan_archival_completeness.py:135-142 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: has_descope_section is satisfied by the mere presence of a ## De-scoped phases heading.
  WHY: The check does not verify that the section contains any listed items beneath it, so an empty heading with no rationale passes the lint.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- tests/test_stall_recovery_pr_lookup.py:807-810 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test helper `_run_create_pr_recovery` creates `runtime_dir` but does NOT create the `${RUNTIME_DIR}/pr-body-lint/body.txt` file that the workflow's "Create Pull Request" step now requires.
  WHY: The workflow step at implement.yml:3874-3876 now hard-exits if the PR body file is missing. The test helper runs the extracted step without the pre-flight step that would create this file, causing the test to fail with: `::error::expected PR body file missing: /tmp/tmp*/runtime/pr-body-lint/body.txt`
- .github/workflows/integration-pr-readiness.yml:72 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: GitHub pull-request context variables (`github.event.pull_request.head.ref` and `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`) are interpolated directly into shell execution context via environment variables.
  WHY: While the values are properly quoted in the shell command, branch names come from user input (PR creator). A malicious branch name could potentially inject shell commands. This matches the unsafe pattern that actionlint flags.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- tests/test_stall_recovery_pr_lookup.py:785-810 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test helper runs the extracted "Create Pull Request" step from implement.yml without creating the PR body file that the step now requires.
  WHY: The hardened implement.yml step added a guard `if [ ! -f "${PR_BODY_FILE}" ]; then echo "::error::expected PR body file missing..."; exit 1; fi`. The test creates RUNTIME_DIR but not `${RUNTIME_DIR}/pr-body-lint/body.txt`, so the guard exits before `gh pr create` runs. This causes test failures `test_create_pr_recovery_finds_existing_linked_open_pr` and `test_create_pr_recovery_picks_first_open_pr_when_multiple_present` seen in the CI log.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- tests/test_stall_recovery_pr_lookup.py:85-130, 785-811 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `_run_create_pr_recovery` test helper creates `RUNTIME_DIR` but does not create `${RUNTIME_DIR}/pr-body-lint/body.txt`; tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py (lines ~3134, ~8455) is also referenced in the source finding.
  WHY: The new guard added in `.github/workflows/implement.yml` (original PR diff, lines 3874-3876) exits 1 immediately when that file is absent, and the test extracts and runs only the "Create Pull Request" step, bypassing the pre-flight lint step that creates the body file.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8595-8601 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The gate filters only `select(.status == "not_created")`.
  WHY: Sub-issues that were dispatched, received a `github_issue` number, and then landed in a non-terminal state like `failed`, `stuck`, or `review-blocked` are not caught; if the integration PR is externally merged in that state, the gate passes and the project transitions to `complete` with work still in flight.
- scripts/check_integration_pr_readiness.py:49-58 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: All failure modes of `gh issue view` (network error, subprocess crash, 404, rate limit, JSON decode failure) collapse to `None`.
  WHY: The caller then posts an error commit status and returns 1, but has no way to distinguish "issue does not exist" from "transient API failure", so the readiness check will fail-closed during GitHub API incidents or rate-limit windows.
- scripts/lint_plan_archival_completeness.py:135-142 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `has_descope_section` is satisfied by the mere presence of a `## De-scoped phases` heading.
  WHY: The check does not verify that the section contains any listed items beneath it. An empty heading with no rationale passes the lint.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
